I1.description: population, finiteness, action feasibility and positive-semidefinite sampled quadratics

I2.description: all S1, S2 and U trajectories charged exactly once and action chosen before U

I3.description: geometric AUC ratio to per-scenario best fixed full-batch pair

I4.description: geometric AUC ratio to privileged exact online diagonal full-batch rule

I5.description: strictly better than exact online diagonal fraction

I6.description: fraction of exact coupled-versus-diagonal aggregate AUC gain recovered

I7.description: fraction of primary seed-scenario cells with coefficient decision regret at most 25 percent of oracle descent

I8.description: target-sensitivity-zero full-sketch versus diagonal-sketch maximum absolute metric difference

I9.description: constant two-action QP and five-scalar interface; no Hessian inverse or learning-rate scan

stop_rule: failure of I4, I5, I6 or I7 permanently stops the coupled-timescale sketch as the ICML mainline; any other failure forbids estimator construction until resolved without changing these outcomes
authorization_on_pass: observable Markov coefficient-estimator derivation only; no formal, GPU or standard MARL benchmark
